university.name: University of Saskatchewan
university.description: Saskatchewan's largest university, located in Saskatoon on Treaty 6 Territory. The College of Arts and Science is the only college in Canada to offer courses in sciences, social sciences, humanities, and fine arts under one roof.

programs.name: Bachelor of Arts (General)
programs.description: A 4-year degree in Canada's only college combining sciences, social sciences, humanities, and fine arts. 120 credit units required. Wide range of majors from Anthropology to Studio Art, with many certificate add-ons available. Affordable tuition compared to BC universities.

tuition.notes: Arts and Science - Arts estimate for 30 credit units (full course load). Category 1 rate: $1,251.10 per credit unit for international students.

requirements.value: 6.5 overall, minimum 6.0 in each component (Reading, Listening, Speaking, Writing)

living_costs.notes: Saskatoon has significantly lower living costs than Vancouver or Toronto. On-campus residence available. Estimates based on typical student budgets for Saskatoon.
